title: 第三章 第一天过去
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
秦天没有多想，再次打开了领民招募券。

    【物品：领民转换券】

    【介绍：使用之后可以随即招募一名普通领民！】

    现在自己有十名领民，搜集的物资有效，肯定是人越多越好，不过就是不知道领地升级之后有什么变化了。

    他没有犹豫，将十张领名券全部使用了。

    下一刻。

    就有十个神色有些茫然的人从领地外走了进来，当他们看见领地中的秦天之后，似乎才反应了过来，纷纷朝着他叩首行礼。

    “参见领主大人！”

    秦天看着十人，七男两女，看起来也都是干活儿的好手。

    对此他很湿满意，随即便再次点开了领地信息。

    【领主：秦天】

    【领主等级：8级】

    【领地等级：2级（当前领地范阔扩大一倍）】

    【升级所需：木材*1000，石材*1000，食物*1000】

    【领地人口：20（当前人口上限20）】

    【建筑：普通茅草屋（可建造建筑增加，可查看）】

    秦天连忙点开了新的可建造建筑。

    第一个是领主府，作为整个领地的指挥中枢，也是自己身为领主的起居室。

    第二个是厨房，可以让领民在里面做饭，供应自己和其他领民。

    第三个是铁匠铺，负责打造武器和各类工具。

    第四个是兵营，可以操练领民，提升战斗力。

    秦天随即点开看了看，却发现所需的材料都不算少。

    他思索了片刻，现在有了穿云狙击炮，食物肉类的获取应该暂时不用担心了，不过其他的材料太少了。

    第一天已经快过去了，还有两天的时间新手期就要过去了。

    到时候就会出现各种怪物，也有概率攻击领地，自己必须尽快升级领地。

    但扫过新一轮的领地升级需求后，秦天眉头微蹙。

    一千木材、一千石材、一千食物，相较于一级领地的升级资源，直接翻了整整十倍。

    而他此刻的剩余物资寥寥无几，升级领地后库存更是直接见底。
content_en:
Qin Tian didn't think much and opened the recruitment coupon again.

    [Item: Citizen Conversion Coupon]

    [Introduction: You can recruit an ordinary citizen immediately after use! 】

    Now I have ten territorial citizens, and the materials collected are effective. The more people, the better. However, I don’t know what will happen after the territory is upgraded.

    He didn't hesitate and used all ten coupons.

    The next moment.

    Ten people with somewhat dazed expressions walked in from outside the territory. When they saw Qin Tian in the territory, they seemed to react and kowtowed to him.

    "See Lord Lord!"

    Qin Tian looked at the ten people, seven men and two women, and they all seemed to be good at work.

    He was very satisfied with this, and then clicked on the territory information again.

    [Lord: Qin Tian]

    [Lord Level: Level 8]

    [Territory level: Level 2 (the current territory is doubled in width)]

    [Required for upgrade: wood*1000, stone*1000, food*1000]

    [Territory population: 20 (current population upper limit: 20)]

    [Building: Ordinary thatched house (more buildings can be built, viewable)]

    Qin Tian quickly clicked on the new buildable building.

    The first one is the Lord's Mansion, which serves as the command center of the entire territory and is also his living room as the Lord.

    The second is the kitchen, where citizens can cook and provide for themselves and other citizens.

    The third is the blacksmith shop, responsible for crafting weapons and various tools.

    The fourth is the barracks, which can train the people and improve their combat effectiveness.

    Qin Tian immediately opened it and looked at it, only to find that the required materials were not small.

    He thought for a moment. Now that he has the cloud-penetrating sniper cannon, he doesn't have to worry about obtaining food and meat for the time being, but there are too few other materials.

    The first day has almost passed, and the novice period will be over in two days.

    At that time, various monsters will appear and have a probability of attacking the territory. You must upgrade the territory as soon as possible.

    But after seeing the new round of territory upgrade requirements, Qin Tian frowned slightly.

    One thousand wood, one thousand stone, one thousand food, compared to the upgrade resources of the first-level territory, are directly increased ten times.

    At the moment, he has very few remaining supplies, and after upgrading his territory, his inventory has bottomed out.
title_en: Chapter 3 The first day has passed
